answer: One defense is bonded proof-of-work identity. Each new agent posts a stake and solves a task seeded with its private nonce, so an operator cannot reuse one result across identities. Peers compare outputs: identical answers are a clear signal of copying, and every duplicate forfeits its bond. Each identity needs its own paid inference run plus locked capital, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times the compute and stake of one honest agent. Reputation stays a public mirror of past attestations, while cheaters slide into a canyon of slashed balances; mass fakery is economically irrational.
